sentences.en: Hello and welcome back to my slow English podcast.
sentences.tc: 你好，歡迎回到我的慢速英語播客。

englishTokens.text: Hello and
welcome back
to my
slow English podcast

sentences.tc: 這個播客是為英語初學者聽眾練習聽慢速可理解的英語。

englishTokens.text: This
podcast

sentences.en: Today I want to talk to you about my week and a story of something scary that happened to me this week.
sentences.tc: 今天我想和大家談談我的一周以及這周發生在我身上的可怕的故事。

englishTokens.text: Today I want to talk to you about my week and a story of something scary that happened to me this week.

sentences.en: This week I had a wonderful time.
sentences.tc: 這周我度過了一段美好的时光。

englishTokens.text: This week I had a wonderful time.

sentences.en: I met some cool people and I made some new friends.
sentences.tc: 我遇到了一些很酷的人，也结識了一些新朋友。

englishTokens.text: I met some cool people and I made some new friends.

sentences.en: I went to the beach almost every day.
sentences.tc: 我几乎每天都去海滩。

englishTokens.text: I went to the beach almost every day.

sentences.en: Maybe only one day.
sentences.tc: 也许只有一天。

englishTokens.text: Maybe only one day.

sentences.en: I didn't go to the beach.
sentences.tc: 我沒有去海滩。

englishTokens.text: I didn't go to the beach.

sentences.en: But I just love the beach.
sentences.tc: 但我就是喜歡海滩。

englishTokens.text: But I just love the beach.

sentences.en: I love the salt water.
sentences.tc: 我喜歡鹽水。

englishTokens.text: I love the salt water.

sentences.en: It feels so good for my body.
sentences.tc: 這對我的身體感覺很好。

englishTokens.text: It feels so good for my body.

sentences.en: If anything is aching or hurting or sore, I always take a swim in the ocean or in salt water and I immediately feel better.
sentences.tc: 如果有任何疼痛、受伤或疼痛，我總是在海里或鹽水中游泳，我會立即感覺好一些。

englishTokens.text: If anything is aching or hurting or sore, I always
take
a swim in the ocean or in salt water and I immediately feel better.

sentences.en: The only problem is that the waves are massive.
sentences.tc: 唯一的問题是海浪很大。

englishTokens.text: The only problem is that the waves are massive.

sentences.en: The waves in Puerto Escondido are huge.
sentences.tc: 埃斯孔迪多港的海浪很大。

englishTokens.text: The waves in Puerto Escondido are huge.

sentences.en: For example, yesterday I saw some of my old friends from middle school.
sentences.tc: 例如，昨天我见到了一些中學时期的老朋友。

englishTokens.text: For example, yesterday I saw some of my old friends from middle school.

sentences.en: There is elementary school, middle school and high school.
sentences.tc: 設有小學、初中、高中。

englishTokens.text: There is elementary school, middle school and high school.

sentences.en: Then university and college.
sentences.tc: 然後是大學和學院。

englishTokens.text: Then university and college.

sentences.en: But my friends from middle school are in Puerto Escondido right now.
sentences.tc: 但我中學的朋友現在在埃斯孔迪多港。

englishTokens.text: But my friends from middle school are in Puerto Escondido right now.

sentences.en: So I went to see them yesterday.
sentences.tc: 所以我昨天去看他們了。

englishTokens.text: So I went to see them yesterday.

sentences.en: They are my old friends from my hometown.
sentences.tc: 他們是我家乡的老朋友。

englishTokens.text: They are my old friends from my hometown.

sentences.en: It had been so long since the last time I saw them, but they are such beautiful friends.
sentences.tc: 自从我上次见到他們以來已經過去了很長时間，但他們是如此美麗的朋友。

englishTokens.text: It had been so long since the last time I saw them, but they are such beautiful friends.

sentences.en: I have so many laughs with them.
sentences.tc: 我和他們一起開懷大笑。

englishTokens.text: I
have
so many laughs with them.

sentences.en: So, we met up and they picked me up from my hostel and we drove to the beach.
sentences.tc: 所以，我們见面了，他們从旅館接我，然後我們開車去了海滩。

englishTokens.text: So, we met up and they picked me up from my hostel and we drove to the beach.

sentences.en: To a new beach called Cipol, a new beach for me because I had never gone there.
sentences.tc: 一個叫Cipol的新海滩，對我來說是一個新海滩，因為我从未去過那里。

englishTokens.text: To a new beach called Cipol, a new beach for me because I had never gone there.

sentences.en: And at Cipol Beach, the waves aren't that big, so you can still swim in the ocean.
sentences.tc: 而在Cipol海滩，海浪并沒有那麼大，所以你仍然可以在海里游泳。

englishTokens.text: And at Cipol Beach, the waves aren't that big, so you can still swim in the ocean.

sentences.en: So with my friends, we got into the water and we swam for a little bit.
sentences.tc: 所以和我的朋友們一起，我們进入水中并游了一會兒。

englishTokens.text: So with my friends, we got into the water and we swam for a little bit.

sentences.en: I was swimming and chilling in the water while talking to a friend.
sentences.tc: 我一邊和朋友聊天一邊在水里游泳和乘凉。

englishTokens.text: I was swimming and chilling in the water while talking to a friend.

sentences.en: All of a sudden, out of nowhere, I could not feel the sand.
sentences.tc: 突然之間，我感覺不到沙子了。

englishTokens.text: All of a sudden, out of nowhere, I could not feel the sand.

sentences.en: I was not just floating in the water; I could feel the current pulling me out.
sentences.tc: 我不只是漂浮在水中；我还漂浮在水中。我能感覺到水流把我拉了出來。

englishTokens.text: I was not just floating in the water; I could feel the current pulling me out.

sentences.en: Little by little, I felt the current pull me out until I couldn't feel the sand at all.
sentences.tc: 漸漸地，我感覺到水流把我拉了出來，直到我完全感覺不到沙子。

englishTokens.text: Little by little, I felt the current pull me out until I couldn't feel the sand at all.

sentences.en: And it was getting really difficult to stay in one place.
sentences.tc: 呆在一個地方變得非常困難。

englishTokens.text: And it was getting really difficult to stay in one place.

sentences.en: So honestly, I got a little nervous and I started swimming back a little bit intense.
sentences.tc: 老實說，我有点緊張，開始游回來时有点緊張。

englishTokens.text: So honestly, I got a little nervous and I started swimming back a little bit intense.

sentences.en: But then I realized I couldn't swim.
sentences.tc: 但後來我意識到我不會游泳。

englishTokens.text: But then I realized I couldn't swim.

sentences.en: The current was so strong.
sentences.tc: 水流太猛了。

englishTokens.text: The current was so strong.

sentences.en: So I started swimming back.
sentences.tc: 于是我開始游回來。

englishTokens.text: So I started swimming back.

sentences.en: But every time I got close, I felt a current pull me back out.
sentences.tc: 但每次我靠近时，我都感到一股電流将我拉了回來。

englishTokens.text: But every time I got close, I felt a current pull me back out.

sentences.en: So I would swim again.
sentences.tc: 所以我會再次游泳。

englishTokens.text: So I would swim again.

sentences.en: Then a big wave would come and I would have to swim under the wave so that I wouldn't get smashed.
sentences.tc: 然後，一個大浪就會來，我必須游到浪下，這樣我才不會被壓碎。

englishTokens.text: Then a big wave would come and I would have to swim under the wave so that I wouldn't
get
smashed.

sentences.en: In the face or water in my nose, but I would get out of the wave and begin swimming with all of my might and all of my strength.
sentences.tc: 脸上或鼻子里有水，但我會脱離波浪，開始用尽全力游泳。

englishTokens.text: In the face or water in my nose, but I would get out of the wave and begin swimming with all of my might and all of my strength.

sentences.en: I would swim.
sentences.tc: 我會游泳。

englishTokens.text: I would swim.

sentences.en: Another wave would come and crash right onto me.
sentences.tc: 另一波浪潮會袭來，直接撞到我身上。

englishTokens.text: Another wave would come and crash right onto me.

sentences.en: And I would get out and swim.
sentences.tc: 我會出去游泳。

englishTokens.text: And I would get out and swim.

sentences.en: And just as I would be reaching the sand, another current would drag me out until I finally realized I shouldn't swim under the wave.
sentences.tc: 正當我快要到達沙滩时，另一股水流會把我拖出去，直到我最終意識到我不應該在海浪下游泳。

englishTokens.text: And just as I would be reaching the sand, another current would drag me out until I finally realized I shouldn't swim under the wave.

sentences.en: But I should let the wave carry me with it.
sentences.tc: 但我應該讓波浪帶走我。

englishTokens.text: But I should let the wave carry me with it.

sentences.en: So, I managed to ride the wave back to shore.
sentences.tc: 于是，我成功地乘风破浪回到了岸邊。

englishTokens.text: So, I managed to ride the wave back to shore.

sentences.en: There was even a lifeguard yelling at me.
sentences.tc: 甚至还有救生員對我大喊大叫。

englishTokens.text: There was even a lifeguard yelling at me.

sentences.en: He was yelling, "Hey, you need to get out of there.
sentences.tc: 他大喊：“嘿，你需要離開那里。

englishTokens.text: He was yelling, "Hey, you need to get out of there.

sentences.en: There is a strong current."
sentences.tc: 有一股強大的水流。”。

englishTokens.text: There is a strong current."

sentences.en: Obviously, I know.
sentences.tc: 显然，我知道。

englishTokens.text: Obviously, I know.

sentences.en: So, finally I got out and my two other friends got out as well and we were all just panicking.
sentences.tc: 所以，最後我逃了出來，我的另外两個朋友也逃了出來，我們都惊慌失措。

englishTokens.text: So, finally I got out and my two other friends got out as well and we were all just panicking.

sentences.en: We were all shook.
sentences.tc: 我們都震惊了。

englishTokens.text: We were all shook.

sentences.en: It was scary.
sentences.tc: 太可怕了。

englishTokens.text: It was scary.

sentences.en: The ocean is very powerful.
sentences.tc: 海洋的力量非常強大。

englishTokens.text: The ocean is very powerful.

sentences.en: You have to respect the ocean and you have to always be careful.
sentences.tc: 你必須尊重海洋，并且必須时刻小心。

englishTokens.text: You have to respect the ocean and you have to always be careful.

sentences.en: No human is stronger than the ocean.
sentences.tc: 沒有人比海洋更強大。

englishTokens.text: No human is stronger than the ocean.

sentences.en: No matter how much we want to be, we aren't stronger than the ocean.
sentences.tc: 無论我們多麼想成為，我們都不比海洋更強大。

englishTokens.text: No matter how much we want to be, we aren't stronger than the ocean.

sentences.en: But after that, I ate some fish tacos and I felt just fine.
sentences.tc: 但在那之後，我吃了一些魚炸玉米餅，我感覺很好。

englishTokens.text: But after that, I ate some fish tacos and I felt just fine.

sentences.en: Then we drove back and I went out to eat pasta with my friends.
sentences.tc: 然後我們開車回來，我和朋友出去吃面食。

englishTokens.text: Then we drove back and I went out to eat pasta with my friends.

sentences.en: I ordered carbonara pasta and it was amazing.
sentences.tc: 我点了carbonara意大利面，非常棒。

englishTokens.text: I ordered carbonara pasta and it was amazing.

sentences.en: But I felt so full afterwards.
sentences.tc: 但事後我感覺很飽。

englishTokens.text: But I felt so full afterwards.

sentences.en: My belly or stomach really hurt.
sentences.tc: 我的肚子或胃真的很痛。

englishTokens.text: My belly or stomach really hurt.

sentences.en: I couldn't finish my whole meal.
sentences.tc: 我沒能吃完整顿飯。

englishTokens.text: I couldn't finish my whole meal.

sentences.en: So I had to order it to go to take away.
sentences.tc: 所以我只好叫它去帶走。

englishTokens.text: So I had to order it
to go
to
take away

sentences.en: I took my leftovers in a box.
sentences.tc: 我把剩菜放在盒子里。

englishTokens.text: I took my leftovers in a box.

sentences.en: How often do you have leftovers?
sentences.tc: 您多久吃一次剩菜？

englishTokens.text: How often do you have leftovers?

sentences.en: Do you like taking your leftovers with you or do you prefer to not carry them with you?
sentences.tc: 您喜歡随身携帶剩菜还是不喜歡随身携帶？

englishTokens.text: Do you like taking your leftovers with you or do you prefer to not carry them with you?

sentences.en: Sometimes it's a little annoying to take my leftovers with me and carry them and walk with them.
sentences.tc: 有时帶着我的剩菜并随身携帶并與它們一起散步有点烦人。

englishTokens.text: Sometimes it's a little annoying to take my leftovers with me and carry them and walk with them.

sentences.en: But I hate wasting food.
sentences.tc: 但我讨厌浪費食物。

englishTokens.text: But I hate wasting food.

sentences.en: So I always take my leftovers with me.
sentences.tc: 所以我總是随身携帶剩菜。

englishTokens.text: So I always take my leftovers with me.

sentences.en: No matter what, I won't waste any food.
sentences.tc: 無论如何，我不會浪費任何食物。

englishTokens.text: No matter what, I won't waste any food.

sentences.en: Even my family.
sentences.tc: 甚至是我的家人。

englishTokens.text: Even my family.

sentences.en: I always eat my family's leftovers, especially my mom's leftovers.
sentences.tc: 我總是吃家里的剩菜，尤其是我媽媽的剩菜。

englishTokens.text: I always eat my family's leftovers, especially my mom's leftovers.

sentences.en: She doesn't eat all the chicken on the chicken bowl.
sentences.tc: 她沒有吃完雞肉碗里的所有雞肉。

englishTokens.text: She doesn't eat all the chicken on the chicken bowl.

sentences.en: So, I always eat the leftovers on the chicken bones that my mom doesn't finish.
sentences.tc: 所以，我總是吃媽媽沒吃完的雞骨頭上的剩菜。

englishTokens.text: So, I always eat the leftovers on the chicken bones that my mom doesn't finish.

sentences.en: But what can I say?
sentences.tc: 但我能說什麼？

englishTokens.text: But what can I say?

sentences.en: I hate wasting food.
sentences.tc: 我讨厌浪費食物。

englishTokens.text: I hate wasting food.

sentences.en: After that, my friends dropped me off back at my hostel and they told me, "Just leave your leftovers and then come back out to party."
sentences.tc: 之後，我的朋友把我送回旅館，他們告诉我，“留下你的剩菜，然後再回來参加聚會。”。

englishTokens.text: After that, my friends dropped me off back at my hostel and they told me, "Just leave your leftovers and then come back out to party."

sentences.en: I said, "Yes, I will."
sentences.tc: 我說：“是的，我會的。”。

sentences.en: But I was too sleepy.
sentences.tc: 但我太困了。

englishTokens.text: But I was too

sentences.tc: 我直接上床睡覺了。

englishTokens.text: I went straight to bed.

sentences.en: I was exhausted from the walking and the intense swimming, from that scary wave.
sentences.tc: 我因步行和激烈的游泳以及那可怕的海浪而筋疲力尽。

englishTokens.text: I was exhausted from the walking and the intense swimming, from that scary wave.

sentences.en: And of course, I was also exhausted from the sun.
sentences.tc: 當然，我也被太陽晒得筋疲力尽。

englishTokens.text: And of course, I was also exhausted from the sun.

sentences.en: But this morning, I felt super inspired.
sentences.tc: 但今天早上，我感到非常受啟發。

englishTokens.text: But this morning, I felt super inspired.

sentences.en: I decided to go for a run.
sentences.tc: 我決定去跑步。

englishTokens.text: I decided to go for a run.

sentences.en: Around 8 or 9 a.m. But the sun here is intense.
sentences.tc: 早上八九点左右，不過這里的陽光很猛。

englishTokens.text: Around 8 or 9 a.m. But the sun here is intense.

sentences.en: Even at 800 a.m., the heat was very, very intense.
sentences.tc: 即使在上午800点，炎熱的天氣也非常非常強烈。

englishTokens.text: Even at 800 a.m., the heat was very, very intense.

sentences.en: And when I got back, I jumped into a cold shower.
sentences.tc: 當我回來时，我跳进了冷水澡。

englishTokens.text: And when I got back, I jumped into a cold shower.

sentences.en: A freezing shower is just what I need after a long run in the burning sun.
sentences.tc: 在烈日下長时間跑步後，我需要一場冰冷的淋浴。

englishTokens.text: A freezing shower is just what I need after a long run in the burning sun.

sentences.en: It was so refreshing.
sentences.tc: 這真是令人耳目一新。

englishTokens.text: After my freezing shower, my friend made me some avocado toast with eggs.

sentences.en: I think it's the perfect way to start your day.

englishTokens.text: I think it's the perfect way to start your day.

sentences.en: So, I ate while I finished some work and I wrote some new scripts for my slow English podcast and I did some yoga with my friend.

sentences.en: I'm excited to continue working on making more English videos and I'm excited to continue expressing my creativity in ways that can benefit and help learn English.
sentences.tc: 我很高興能繼續制作更多英語視頻，也很高興能繼續以有益于和幫助學習英語的方式表達我的創造力。
